retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s studio portrait layout featuring a smiling male subject in a textured suit against a soft-focus olive green background with left-aligned condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close studio portrait of a smiling man in a blue windowpane check blazer and black shirt, positioned off-center against a smooth, vignetted olive green backdrop. The composition is anchored by a block of left-aligned, condensed sans-serif text in the upper-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center looking toward the viewer
Text block balanced against the subject's head in the upper-left
Cool blue tones of the jacket contrasting with the warm olive background
Soft studio lighting creating gentle highlights on the face and hair
coreInvariants: Blue windowpane check pattern on the blazer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, from chest up, scaled to dominate the height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point, balanced by the text block in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move left to the title text, then down through the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left and top edges, filled with a soft green gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Olive green background with soft vignetting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cornflower blue with white windowpane checks in the blazer.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow and white for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation typical of 1960s film photography; mid-range values with soft shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the display text
Slightly rounded terminals in the secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned 'y' and 'A' in the main name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Tonal contrast between white and pale yellow using the same condensed sans-serif family in different weights.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight of the primary name text.
Matches the cleaner, mid-century feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a smiling man in his 40s with short brown hair, wearing a cornflower blue windowpane check blazer over a black shirt. The background should be a smooth, vignetted olive green studio backdrop. Lighting should be soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add left-aligned condensed sans-serif text in the upper-left quadrant. The top line should be pale yellow, the main name below it in large white bold letters, and a list of smaller pale yellow text lines below that.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vignetted olive green?
Is the blazer a blue windowpane check pattern?
Is the text left-aligned in the upper-left quadrant?
Is the typography a condensed sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the windowpane check on the jacket is visible and consistent.
Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the olive green background has a smooth gradient/vignette.
Confirm the typography uses a condensed sans-serif style.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Windowpane Blazer + Olive Vignette + Condensed Left-Aligned Type
